methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly and re-verified for PandaDoc (pandadoc.com/pricing), Concord (concord.app/pricing), DocuSign IAM (ecom.docusign.com/plans-and-pricing/iam), Ironclad (ironcladapp.com/pricing), Juro (juro.com/pricing), Agiloft (agiloft.com/pricing), Gatekeeper (gatekeeperhq.com/pricing and gatekeeperhq.com/pricing-details), and related security pages. PandaDoc (Free/Starter/Business), Concord (Essentials/Business/Enterprise) and DocuSign IAM (Starter/Standard/Professional) publish exact prices and were confirmed. Ironclad, Juro and Agiloft are confirmed quote-only with no published tiers (monthlyUsd=null). Gatekeeper publishes plan/quota tiers but NO dollar amounts on either official page; all monthlyUsd=null and third-party price figures are excluded from price fields. ContractWorks correction: the official pricing URL (contractworks.com/contract-management-software-pricing) 301-redirects to a LIVE page onit.com/products/clm/contractworks/ which shows only Standard/Premium tiers (by document storage) with NO published dollar amounts and a 'Request Free Trial' CTA; the previously asserted $600/mo flat price came only from third-party aggregators (which conflict: $500/$600/$700) and is NOT vendor-published, so monthlyUsd is set to null per no-guess policy. Telephony fields are null (not a telephony vertical). All accessedAt=2026-06-15.

vendors.name: PandaDoc
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched and confirmed from pandadoc.com/pricing (Free $0, Starter $19/seat/mo annual, Business $49/seat/mo annual, Enterprise custom). BAA confirmed via pandadoc.com/hipaa (customers must request BAA via support to transmit ePHI); compliance from pandadoc.com/security/compliance.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0 forever-free. 60 documents per year, unlimited seats, drag-and-drop editor, real-time tracking. No credit card required.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $19/seat/mo billed annually ($35/seat/mo billed monthly). 110 documents per year, unlimited seats, audit trail, bulk import, inline comments, 24/7 support. Additional documents $2 each. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $49/seat/mo billed annually ($65/seat/mo billed monthly). Unlimited documents, CRM integrations, custom branding, deal rooms, approval workflows, CPQ. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom per-seat or per-document pricing ('Let's talk'). Includes CPQ, workflow automation, smart content, SSO, team workspaces, notary, API access. Contact sales.

limits: Free plan: 60 documents/year
Starter: 110 documents/year
Business and above: unlimited documents
keyFeatures: Document generation with drag-and-drop editor
Built-in CPQ and deal rooms on Business+
HIPAA-compliant with BAA available on request
Native CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing and features re-verified from pandadoc.com/pricing; compliance from pandadoc.com/security/compliance; HIPAA BAA from pandadoc.com/hipaa (requested via support).

vendors.name: Concord
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched and confirmed from concord.app/pricing (Essentials $499, Business $899, Enterprise $1,299/mo billed annually, each incl. 5 users). Security from concord.app/security: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 confirmed; HIPAA is listed only as an AWS hosting-infrastructure standard, not an application-layer certification, so hipaa=null.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $499/mo billed annually. Includes 5 users; additional users $49/mo each. Unlimited e-signatures, unlimited documents, AI Copilot and extraction, deadline reminders, amendment management. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $899/mo billed annually. Includes 5 users; additional users $69/mo each. Adds intake forms, approval workflows, custom roles/teams, customized reports, Salesforce and HubSpot integrations. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $1,299/mo billed annually. Includes 5 users; additional users $89/mo each. Volume discounts available. Adds clause library, subsidiary management, bulk send, open API, custom branding. Confirmed on live page.

limits: All plans include 5 users; additional users billed per user per month on top of flat fee
No forever-free plan (free trial referenced in FAQ, no published duration)
keyFeatures: Transparent flat-rate pricing with no per-envelope fees
AI Copilot and data extraction on all plans
Clause library and bulk send on Enterprise
Unlimited e-signatures on all plans
enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-verified from concord.app/pricing; SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 from concord.app/security; HIPAA is AWS-infra only (application-layer not claimed), so hipaa=null.

vendors.name: DocuSign IAM (includes CLM)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched and confirmed from ecom.docusign.com/plans-and-pricing/iam (Starter $45/user/mo, Standard $50/user/mo with 3-user min, Professional $80/user/mo with 3-user min, Enterprise custom). DocuSign CLM is embedded in IAM as Agreement Manager. HIPAA BAA available for eligible/enterprise tiers (DocuSign healthcare docs), so hipaa=true, baa=true.

plans.name: IAM Starter
plans.notes: $45/user/mo billed annually ($540/user/yr). 1-50 users. 100 envelope sends/user/year, 1 workflow, Agreement Manager (contract repository, AI extraction, bulk upload) with unlimited new-doc processing + one-time 5,000 historical docs/user. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: IAM Standard
plans.notes: $50/user/mo billed annually. 3-user minimum ($150/mo minimum). Unlimited envelopes via web app, 3 workflows, Agreement Manager with unlimited new-doc processing + 5,000 historical docs/user. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: IAM Professional
plans.notes: $80/user/mo billed annually. 3-user minimum ($240/mo minimum). 10 workflows, eSignature Business Pro features, AI capabilities, AI-Assisted Review for redlining. Confirmed on live page.

plans.name: IAM Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Contact sales. Full CLM enterprise features. Standalone legacy DocuSign CLM also quote-only.

limits: IAM Standard and Professional require 3-user minimum
5,000 historical document allotment (one-time) per user
IAM Starter lacks AI-Assisted Review
keyFeatures: Agreement Manager: AI-powered contract repository across all IAM plans
AI-Assisted Review for redlining (Professional+)
Deep Salesforce integration
Part of broader DocuSign IAM ecosystem with eSign
HIPAA BAA available for eligible plans
enrichment.provenance: Pricing re-verified from ecom.docusign.com/plans-and-pricing/iam; CLM embedded in IAM as Agreement Manager; HIPAA/BAA per DocuSign healthcare documentation.
